definition: Project Debater is an IBM artificial intelligence project, designed to participate in a full live debate with expert human debaters.
details: It follows on from the Watson project which played Jeopardy!
story: Picture an engineer at a cluttered workbench, turning a clever idea over in their hands until it finally clicks. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. A small key that opens a much bigger door. It is one of those ideas that feels obvious only after someone shows it to you. And that idea, made concrete, is Project Debater.
